scope: Train-defined cohort of reviewers with at least three positive in-catalog training games. This is not a representative sample of all Steam users. Collect complete accessible public histories within the fixed window and catalogue; do not require future positives, fixed reviews per item, or an all-time k-core. Graph interactions can have any language; opinion-training candidates require English detection, sufficient text and historical availability.
protocol_note: Sampling-feasibility revision after the v2 50-profile calibration: use a full validation year and a longer test horizon; prioritize repeat-game evidence found only in pre-2024 seed records. No ranking models or test ranking metrics were run. This is a historical long-horizon task, not a current-session next-game claim.
